name: ATMOSPHERE OS — SEO INDEXABILITY & PWA NAVIGATION
changes: Keeps the homepage explicitly indexable with one robots directive, one meta description and the root canonical URL
Prevents a first-time Service Worker installation from reloading the page during Lighthouse and PageSpeed audits
Retries the real navigation request when Navigation Preload fails before showing the offline document
Adds SEO/indexability regression checks across all 71 HTML pages
Refreshes homepage sitemap metadata and synchronizes active storefront release markers to v16.0.7
notes: The noindex result in the supplied PageSpeed screenshot matched the offline fallback document, not the actual homepage source.
Cart, account, thank-you, order status, admin, compare and offline utility pages intentionally remain noindex.
No catalog, product, cart, payment, promo, account data, Supabase schema or Edge Function logic changed.
